Agent Name: Narration_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error by hallucinating the ability to watch and listen to the video. As an AI text model, the agent cannot actually "watch" a video file or "listen" to audio narration to identify specific timestamps or spoken numbers. Instead of acknowledging this limitation and relying on the failed API attempt or searching for a transcript/caption file, the agent fabricated the process of watching the video at "2:30" and "listening" to the narration to conclude the number was "65 million". This entire sequence (Step 3 onwards) was based on a false premise of sensory perception capabilities, leading to an unverified and likely incorrect answer derived from training data association rather than actual evidence from the specific video requested.
